rpt-mainline030-opus-register-1020.body: MAINLINE-030 filed: a snapshot at 01:15 PDT. 030b refiles when 022c, 025, 026, 028b, 015b, 029 and six checks land. P2 lead, 021 rev1: S-200F faces of 0.8434 mm at 290 GPa on CR-III 5056 3/8-1.0 (20.21 mm), at 5% margin, with every mode at 1 on two optimisms: gamma 0.595 (2.98x CR-1457's 0.20) and wrinkling 0.371 (1.12x 0.33). Today it is 0.336. On 019's reserve (021b, SR-200 sheet) it needs gamma 0.468, wrinkling 0.609 and 3.13 m panels against 0.914 m stock; today it is 0.427. Gamma is the whole margin. P3 lead, 022b: 1.375 at s 6.15 m. On that 40-node frame the smeared buckle half-wave is 0.57 of a member, so the global formula does not apply (NFI-030-CONTINUUM, computed). Inside the band, SiC with both 011b fixes is 1.130 at 100 kg and 5%, film-limited, on a 1.5 GPa film that does not exist (13x Kapton's specific strength). Today's materials give 0.41 to 0.74. Register: 362 NFI rows from 41 reports, merged into 86 rows with every id, report and file kept; 19 carry a check outcome. Ledger: 14 lead corrections and 74 check corrections. Ground first: (1) a sandwich-gamma FE at Vc 0.9 to 1.1, CPU only, retiring all of P2's margin; (2) a discrete buckling run of the P3 frame; (3) 020's weighed, sealed joint panel; (4) an SR-200 thin-sheet spec, which needs the Admiral's authorization to contact a supplier; (5) a wrinkling coupon. Every value is QUESTIONABLE; nothing here is a certification.

rpt-ref-d907de1e97319ecc3f9a.body:
MAINLINE-028b complete on 019’s fixed 411.299 kg reserve, with stock-envelope panels and geometry-dependent 028 joining. Two adjustable factors suffice in each commissioned case: gamma and wrinkling; no singleton works. AF’s fixed 0.015 film remains original O5 at full, so it is not erased from the optimism accounting.

SR-200 uses 1850 kg/m³, 290 GPa and the explicit 345 MPa tensile-as-compression assumption. The exact 021b nu=0.33 comparison is preserved; the sheet-based scalar nu=0.0752 check is reported separately. Enforcing 028’s assumed 10 MPa scarf-shear screen gives maximum remaining usages 0.971978 nominal, 0.996076 primer and 0.651469 laboratory bond/ideal weld. Physical joining at the resized points is 215.742, 227.880 and 50.151 kg. Only excess above the existing joint allowance is charged; the laboratory case retains its unused allowance. All factors, subsets, six continuum modes and seam screens are tabulated.

The nominal/primer six-mode optima alone fail the scarf screen. After enforcing it, full-endpoint reoptimized SF is only 1.006358/1.002803. Bond, peel, weld/HAZ and other local modes remain unqualified; installed-hull SF is unknown.

The 255 MPa sensitivity has no floating set: even a zero-core face-only upper bound is SF=0.958217. Optimized full-endpoint SFs are 0.869846/0.866848/0.870902.

Twelve checks passed; 16 upstream pins verified; 22 NFI rows. No successor is named. Awaiting the next queued job.

No probability-qualified full-size compression allowable is established. With k=0.2 and the NASA local sensitivity, reoptimized equilateral/inherited pressure multipliers are: SiC Fc380 MPa 0.45120/0.26050; assumed Fc1 GPa 1.16866/0.67954; unqualified Fc3.9 GPa 1.20571/1.07575. Mixed CMC Fc580 MPa gives 0.87116/0.50298. All are QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION.

allowable.py and ALLOWABLE-INTERFACE.md supply tube-size and stressed-volume/surface functions for 022b, both force rules, and explicit null compression qualification. Tensile Weibull hypotheses are not compression allowables. No public source demonstrates the complete curved 247 mm OD, 0.88 mm wall, 2.04 m product. Film-sag loss remains assigned to 024/022b; the retained mass budget has zero spare lift.

Seventeen model, nine interface and twenty-eight packaging/cross-calculation checks pass; eleven inherited/amendment pins verified. CARD, RESULTS, INPUTS, sixteen-row NFI, source memos, scripts and manifest are pinned. All delegates finished. No successor is named; awaiting robotics dispatch as CARD-025 directs.

rpt-ref-4f09fd6b4c4dd848ebb0.body:
MAINLINE-024, the P3 film. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification.

The pillow radius is the 2.04 m bay, because the 011b formula is p = 2*sigma*t/s. Cap rise is 0.374346974907 m. The arc line load is 97370.0546722 N/m. At the pinned 80 um the stress is 1217125683.4 Pa. The own scan reproduces least factor 1.22552794688, global, at s 2.04 m.

Kapton HN at half of 231 MPa is 0.000843030776382 m and 1504.3248789 kg. Teonex Q51 at half of 210 MPa is 1584.83804143 kg. Both exist as films. Kapton oxygen is 0.00404221907772 kg/day and nitrogen is 0.0031593001418 kg/day. The scaled water row is 2.01233463886 kg/day and is not a hull humidity. The 016 allowance is 48.8944215019 kg/day. The 150 to 400 kg pump holds those sourced loads. No getter was opened.

The lightest design row is Zylon HM as a 0/90 filament at 60 percent of break, a Toyobo extrapolation of about 19 years. Mass 109.701010474 kg, 0.0872972903957 kg/m2. It is not a sourced film, resin is omitted, and a barrier is still required. Metallised 12 um Mylar passes 0.000177008068742 kg/day of oxygen. Nitrogen is not on that sheet. The structure alone is above 97.515 kg.

That mass restates the k 0.2 least factor to 1.15909090909, film, second global, at s 1.76 m. The Kapton mass restates it to 0.818028264063, global, at s 2.48 m. CNT sheet and graphene laminate have no opened allowable. PROJECTION. The brief names no next job.

rpt-ref-2bb3c2b520a8e5f8c750.body:
MAINLINE-024, the film sag charged as lift. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification. The filed film card is not rewritten.

The charged sphere has radius s on the triangle inradius. The crown is 0.0868487001771 m at s 2.04 m and 0.127718676731 m at s 3 m, against the note's about 0.087 m and 0.13 m. The mean is 0.503624902308 of the crown. Lift lost is 64.1580396987 kg at 2.04 m and 94.3500583804 kg at 3 m, against about 64 kg and 94 kg. At s 2 m the loss is 62.9000389203 kg. At s 4 m it is 125.800077841 kg.

A sphere through the vertices crowns at 0.374346974907 m at s 2.04 m and would cost 283.797315897 kg. It is shown and not charged.

The lightest system on s 2 to 4 m is Zylon HM 0/90 at s 2 m: film 107.550010269 kg plus lift loss 62.9000389203 kg, together 170.450049189 kg. Crown over thickness is 1551.98370605 at every bay, because both scale with s. Metallised mass is still unknown. The total is above 97.515 kg. Kapton HN plus that lift is 1537.72835156 kg at s 2 m.

Thickness follows s, so the film factor is 1. At that bay the briefed least factor is 1, governing film. Global is 1.00040754097. Closure equals the lift. Yield, Euler, local and Perry times sqrt(3) leave the least at 1, still film. The highest briefed factor on s 2 to 4 m is 1 at s 2 m. This does not replace the 011b scan.

The CFRP wrap is 0.015 kg per end and 31.0 kg, 0.14 times 225.5 kg. Frozen least SF 1.232, film. Re-optimised least SF 1.466 at k 0.2 and 2.061 at k 0.4. It is the lightest. The coupon exists today. The joint is a PROJECTION.

The titanium sleeve is 0.075 kg per end and 157.7 kg. Frozen least SF 1.232. Invar is 858.6 kg, 3.81 times the allowance, and now closes at frozen SF 1.054. The braze is 0.062 kg per end and 130.6 kg. The pin is 0.202 kg and bears at 11.9 GPa. It does not fit. Wall stress is 824.7 MPa: SF 4.73 on 3900 MPa and 0.461 on 380 MPa. The 5 percent search moves to s 1.78 m, least SF 1.406, global. These paths were rewritten for this fix. NFI-023-EQUILIBRIUM-FORCE. No next job is named.

rpt-ref-7ce5b278fa083d87105b.body:
MAINLINE-026 complete as a QUESTIONABLE elastic-model study. The frequency-6 frame has 362 joints and 1080 arcs. Rigid-joint linear lambda converges to 6.46522 versus 011b’s 6.12764; representative low modes are global lattice modes. Freely rolling ball pins have 1080 zero-strain member-roll mechanisms, so no positive pressure reserve is established without film or anti-roll stiffness.

Refined nonlinear limits are 5.10740 perfect, 4.95038 for 10 mm joint offsets, 5.08261 for 2.04 mm member crookedness, and 4.53958 for the 10 mm first-mode imperfection. Knockdowns are 0.702–0.790 against discrete perfect linear, or 0.741–0.834 against 011b’s continuum; mesh changes are below 0.7%. These prescribed elastic cases do not validate design k=0.2 or 0.4.

Triangular tributary loading is ps/(2sqrt(3)), not the inherited local ps/2. Discrete mass exceeds inherited lift by 61.40 kg. The inherited wall screen reaches nominal unity near lambda 2.03; computed elastic-limit axial stresses exceed the typical compression strength. No certification.

Code, modes, figures, runtimes, four passing verification suites and 12 NFI rows are pinned through the 263-file manifest. Rejected tangent linearization, replaced diagnostics, one memory-cap failure and one recovered outer receipt are disclosed. All 30 own admissions ended/released; no live work. Stop and file; robotics sends the next job.

rpt-ref-5f14d083ceae03234596.body:
MAINLINE-036 complete. No matched minimum compressive yield for finished thin SR-200 faces was established. The maker's 345 MPa minimum is tensile; inspected MIL-HDBK-5J/MMPDS sheet Fcy cells are blank. Historical thicker-sheet compression supports plausibility, not gauge/process/biaxial qualification. PS-200/PF-60 catalogs add no compression basis.

Held R10 requirements are 300.333 MPa for the scarf routes and 321.580 MPa for light bond/ideal weld. Held R20 requires 338.744 MPa face stress and 376.382 MPa material strength with its 0.9 joint efficiency. Re-optimization preserves each predecessor's pressure, reserves and joining law.

With full projected gamma/wrinkling and catalog E=290 GPa, R10 minimum strengths are 298.906 MPa nominal scarf, 300.135 primer, and 298.257 light-bond routes. R20 needs 375.839 MPa under original elastic inputs, or 381.612 MPa with handbook sheet scalar elasticity; historical 379.2 then yields only SF=0.994817. Scalar elasticity is itself unvalidated for the formed orthotropic hull.

Compression qualification is an additional unresolved material assumption. Existing buckling, wrinkling and joining assumptions remain open; installed-hull SF is unknown. Gauge tolerances and additional finishing are treated separately without double-counting etch.

Seventeen input pins and 218 checks passed; 14 evidence rows and 15 NFI items filed. Brief names no successor: stop and file, awaiting robotics' next queued job.

rpt-ref-244f32e2449e729d312f.body:
MAINLINE-034 complete, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. For the inherited 24-hour mission, select ground evacuation then sealed service at an estimated 30–50 kg onboard for both leads; retain the existing 100 kg allowance. Assembly gas-load measurement and evacuation of every cell/bore remain conditions.

Conditioned source-rate hot-pressure limits are 398.2/7.76/19.49 days for P2/Kapton P3/Zylon-barrier P3. Times to 48.894 kg free gas are 464.9/13.97/35.83 days. These are conditional gas calculations, not qualified endurance; the assumed power package supports at most nine days of 5 W monitoring.

Both P3 frames are SiC; CFRP denotes end wraps. Unvented ambient air would retain 43.4/88.2/76.1 kg. Outgassing changes phase of existing onboard mass; external ingress adds mass, and getters retain it. Water beds and powered pumps are explicitly sized; the continuous P3 benchmark is 292.3 kg and its Kapton speed is 2.3% short under assumed conductance.

Zylon vacuum equipment plus barrier/attachment and fitting adhesive totals 91.6–111.6 kg; no payload credit. Kapton structural SF remains below one.

36 numerical/source checks pass; 53 upstream/prior pins unchanged. The manifest pins 77 files, including sources, calculator, curves and delivery checks. Seventeen nonblocking physical/source NFIs remain. No upstream code inspected, imported or run. Stop-and-file instruction fulfilled; no successor named.

rpt-ref-6c81b0b188ad134a3ea2.body:
MAINLINE-022d complete; QUESTIONABLE throughout. All 32 combinations have overall and half-wave-constrained optima: 64 full SF, binding-mode, spacing and mass rows. Both Zylon plies are charged. Ti/CFRP joint dimensions and mass use each candidate's multiplier. Film gauge is continuous; tensile bending is constrained at Ft=15.586 MPa, PROJECTION.

Best equilateral overall: Zylon/CFRP, cap, 5% reserve, SF 1.397732582 at s=6.085747 m, half-wave/member=0.569022. Best equilateral screened: SF 1.258252477 at s=3.170759 m; local/global/film bind. Its masses are tubes 4183.590, film 214.542, joints 44.191, nodes 2.927, systems 100, reserve 244.472 and sag lift loss 99.720 kg. Membrane screened SF is 1.251857092; 019 reserve gives 1.194121426 cap and 1.187857743 membrane.

The two-way surrogate numerically leads at 2.010980577 overall and 1.867825477 screened, but its missing shear stiffness leaves those capacities unqualified. Square-cell sag/wave sensitivity lowers the latter to 1.728882831. Passing one-member half-wave is only the requested screen.

Sixteen overall optima fail that screen. Independent reconstruction passes 2800 checks; 112 optimized sensitivity witnesses and eleven open NFI are filed. Wider bounds improve none of sixteen checked cap optima. Qualified full-size allowable and assembly failure probability remain unknown. No next job.
